profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Developer specializing in Swift for iOS mobile development. C# & .NET for backend. Experience in: HTTP Network Design, best practices for mobile development,SOLID principles, Test Driven Development, and more. 

Now Leveraging the power of Agentic Software delivery with Claude Code, MCP, and whatever comes next.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Managing the delivery of Powertrack Software as a Service. 
Delivering our signature meter asset management platform on web and deployable on any architecture, coming in 2027.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Claude Code · Model Context Protocol (MCP) · Visual Basic .NET (VB.NET) · .NET Framework · React.js · Agentic Automation

positions.title: Chief Executive Officer
positions.description: I lead a team of capable and united agents that get work done for you, at the speed of the future.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: Raleigh, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Working with Verizon’s largest authorized retailer to support store employees with a mobile app experience to handle tasks and sales management.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Backend Architecture: Engineered and maintained robust C# backend services to support enterprise-level mobile applications, ensuring high availability and data consistency.

• Database Engineering: Authored and optimized complex SQL Stored Procedures to manage critical business logic and transaction processing at scale.

• API & DTO Strategy: Designed and implemented Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) to streamline communication between SQL databases and mobile frontends, reducing payload overhead.

• DevOps & Deployment: Utilized Azure DevOps for version control and CI/CD processes, ensuring stable and automated deployment cycles for backend services.

• Mobile Integration: Leveraged SwiftUI and Swift Concurrency to build performant iOS features that consumed backend services, ensuring seamless data synchronization.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description: Working with a clean energy company to develop a Developer Community to support their smart home electricity meters. Provisioning those devices to the home WiFi networks of the end users.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Advanced iOS Development: Developed feature-rich applications using Swift and the Firebase SDK, managing real-time data streaming and authentication.

• Lifecycle Management: Owned the end-to-end development of mobile features, from initial architectural design to deployment and post-launch monitoring.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description: Worked with a leading Auto Insurer to deliver a best in class telematics platform to policyholders. Built an SDK for monitoring Telemetry data used for detecting when a trip has started or stopped, crash events, and distracted/unsafe driving habits. Preprocessed all trip data in batches to be uploaded to cloud for evaluation and storage on behalf of the auto insurance company.
positions.insights: Skills: UIKit · iOS Design · CoreMotion · White Label

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description: Worked with a SCRUM team to deliver releases of a best-in-class- Point of Sale experience to end customers. As part of a smaller team, adapted the legacy product to iOS using Swift. Worked with Unit Tests, Accessibility Features, and UI Test Automation using XCUITest.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Projects from this time frame included Comcast, GEICO, and DicksSporting Goods. All virtually the same scope, I developed UI and front end logic in Swift for native iOS apps as a relatively junior developer.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
Worked on AGILE teams with Dicks Sporting Goods, Comcast and BPN to deliver products aimed to drive business from the iOS platform. 
- Designed and built a sales management tool using Comcast Business  using APIs and the Google Maps SDK to help field representatives better manage their sales funnel on the job in real time. 
- Maintained a full scale production app with over 1 million daily active users for Dicks Sporting Goods. Implemented Unit Testing coverage over the entirety of the app and facilitated its transition to maintenance mode. 
- Worked with SwiftUI to develop a frontend for a mobile e-commerce platform using Shopify's GraphQL based Storefront API.
positions.insights: Skills: UIKit · GoogleMapsSDK · REST APIs · SwiftUI · GraphQL

positions.title: iOS Student @ DevMountain Academy
positions.description: Elevated my iOS skills over the course of a 3 month program in the Utah Valley Area. Worked on a team of student designers and developers at Dev Mountain to create a personal Journaling app. Reported to a Project Manager throughout the project and conducted weekly sprints in a SCRUM format to track progress towards the goal continuously.

projects.title: Rummage
projects.description: A cross-platform app built with Flutter/Dart and a backend using Go (Golang). The app is designed to help find and advertise local Garage Sales with descriptions of items for sale, schedule, and location. Designed using Firebase and MongoDB for record storage.
